item.title: US, India reach interim trade deal lowering tariffs on both countries' goods and agricultural products
item.description: A major trade breakthrough comes as the U.S. and India agree to cut tariffs on goods, with India committing to $500 billion in American purchases over five years.

item.title: 'He Gets Us' debuts new Super Bowl ad with hope for viewers to ‘take a step towards Jesus’
item.description: Come Near's latest Super Bowl ad takes a personal approach, inviting viewers to consider Jesus' perspective on modern societal pressure and expectations.

item.title: Housing shortages push 3D-printed homes from experiment to reality
item.description: 3D-printed homes are transforming U.S. housing markets as builders tackle shortages and rising costs with faster, stronger construction methods nationwide.

item.title: Super Bowl commercials break with traditional male audience to target Gen Z and women viewers
item.description: Company executives are broadening their upcoming Super Bowl advertisements to appeal to more female and Gen Z viewers ahead of the Big Game Sunday night.

item.title: AI leaders argue software will adapt — not die — but valuations are stretched
item.description: Major tech companies lost $1 trillion in a market sell-off this week, sending chills across tech industry. However, I unicorn founders believe valuations will normalize.

item.title: Russian forces lose key battlefield advantage after Starlink terminals abruptly shut down
item.description: Starlink terminals used by Russian forces have been shut down, causing severe communications problems and halting assault operations on the battlefield.

item.title: Super Bowl ads see Bradley Cooper, Matthew McConaughey going head-to-head while Lady Gaga sings her heart out
item.description: Super Bowl commercials 2025 feature Bradley Cooper, Matthew McConaughey, Ben Affleck and Lady Gaga in star-studded celebrity-packed ads for major brands.

item.title: Super Bowl tickets hit as high as $30,000 ahead of the Patriots-Seahawks showdown
item.description: Super Bowl LX ticket prices hit shocking heights with the cheapest seats at $3,590 and the most expensive tickets hitting $30,112 at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara.

item.title: Puka Nacua keeps Super Bowl presence alive in Toyota’s game day commercial
item.description: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua won’t play in the Super Bowl but will still appear during the big game in a new Toyota commercial.

item.title: Hims & Hers responds to FDA pressure, pulls knockoff Wegovy drug launch after regulatory threats
item.description: Telehealth company Hims & Hers cancels $49 monthly weight loss drug launch following FDA warnings about unapproved semaglutide compounds and Novo threats.
